svg.aria-label: The science: from digital numbers to reflectance, indices, masks, learned models, series, change points and elevation differences
svg.text: The science, step by step: every box is a method on the Methods page, with its equation and its source
La ciencia, paso a paso: cada caja es un metodo de la pagina Metodos, con su ecuacion y su fuente
0 From archived digital numbers to surface reflectance, with each archive's own quality mask
0 De los numeros digitales archivados a reflectancia de superficie, con la mascara de calidad de cada archivo
Sentinel-2 L2A: rho = (DN - 1000) / 10000 (baseline 04.00+); SCL 0, 1, 3, 8, 9, 10 invalid, 11 snow
Landsat C2 L2: rho = 0.0000275 DN - 0.2; QA_PIXEL bits fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, shadow, snow
quality masks flag the mine itself (bright benches read
las mascaras marcan la propia mina (bancos claros como
as cloud), so the QA verdict is kept per pixel, not applied
nube), asi el veredicto QA se guarda por pixel, no se aplica
1 What am I looking at
1 Que estoy mirando
p2 to p98 stretch, gamma 1/1.35, printed
estiramiento p2 a p98, gamma 1/1,35, impreso
M2 NDVI = (B8 - B4) / (B8 + B4)
floors 0.02 (two bands), 0.04 (BSI), else NaN
pisos 0,02 (dos bandas), 0,04 (BSI), si no NaN
M3 Fe3+ = B4/B2 OH = B11/B12 Fe2+ = B12/B8A
indicators of mineral groups, never maps
indicadores de grupos minerales, no mapas
2 Where is the mine (classical, then learned)
2 Donde esta la mina (clasico, luego aprendido)
M4 t* = argmax w0 w1 (mu0 - mu1)^2 on BSI
M = [BSI > t*] [NDVI < 0.2] [MNDWI < 0]
then a 3 x 3 opening; small components dropped
luego una apertura 3 x 3; componentes pequenas fuera
M5 k-means++ on z(bands, NDVI, MNDWI), Lloyd
M6 theta = arccos(x.e/|x||e|), e = polygons
M7 forest: 16 features, 64 trees, depth 12
M8 U-Net 32..512, BCE + Dice, 7.85 M params
Jasansky 2024; catalog sites held out; ONNX parity gates
Jasansky 2024; sitios del catalogo retenidos; paridad ONNX
3 How did it change
3 Como cambio
M9 dv = v(t2) - v(t1); |dv| above Otsu;
phi = atan2(dBSI, -dNDVI) names the kind
M10 CUSUM S_t = max(0, S_t-1 + dA_t - mu0 - k),
alarm when S_t > h; k = 0.5 s, h = 4 s
PELT min sum C(seg) + beta m, beta = 3 s^2 ln n
s = 1.4826 MAD of yearly differences; segments of 3+ years
s = 1,4826 MAD de las diferencias; segmentos de 3+ anos
M11 y = a + b t + sum_k [c_k cos(2 pi k t/T)
+ d_k sin(2 pi k t/T)], breaks by BIC, T = 365 d
the signal: mined area per year inside the envelope
la senal: area minada por ano dentro de la envolvente
4 How much rock moved
4 Cuanta roca se movio
M12 dh = h_COP - (h_SRTM + (N96 - N2008)) - b, b = median(dh | stable ground)
tau = 2 * 1.4826 MAD(dh | stable); V_cut = sum(dh < -tau) |dh| a; V_fill = sum(dh > tau) dh a; a = 900 m2
stable ground: outside the envelope and slope below 10 degrees on the Copernicus surface; both surfaces
terreno estable: fuera de la envolvente y pendiente bajo 10 grados en la superficie Copernicus; ambas
warped to the 30 m grid with each tile's extent taken from its alpha band (the Copernicus COGs declare no no-data).
reproyectadas a 30 m con la extension de cada tesela tomada de su banda alfa (los COG Copernicus no declaran no-data).
Antamina, first run: geoid -3.60 m, bias -2.22 m, floor 2.77 m, tau 5.53 m, cut 586 Mm3, fill 916 Mm3 in the envelope.
Antamina, primera corrida: geoide -3,60 m, sesgo -2,22 m, piso 2,77 m, tau 5,53 m, corte 586 Mm3, relleno 916 Mm3.
Two rules that keep the numbers honest
Dos reglas que mantienen honestos los numeros
The envelope: the reference polygons dilated by 1 km.
La envolvente: los poligonos de referencia dilatados 1 km.
Areas and volumes are measured inside it; a mask over
Areas y volumenes se miden dentro; una mascara sobre
the whole window would measure the desert.
toda la ventana mediria el desierto.
Held out: every catalog site is removed from training
Retenido: cada sitio del catalogo sale del entrenamiento
and validation; no number on a site card is in-sample.
y la validacion; ningun numero de una ficha es en muestra.
The held-out matrix (models/benchmark.json, rendered on the Methods page)
La matriz retenida (models/benchmark.json, en la pagina Metodos)
M4 to M8 on the same validation, test and catalog-holdout tiles; pooled IoU, F1, precision, recall; per-tile IoU; boundary F1 at 2 px; per mine type;
M4 a M8 sobre las mismas teselas de validacion, prueba y retencion; IoU, F1, precision y exhaustividad agrupadas; IoU por tesela; F1 de borde a 2 px; por tipo;
the learned methods under added haze (0.02, 0.05, 0.10 reflectance). Validation chooses the SAM angle and nothing else.
los metodos aprendidos con bruma anadida (0,02, 0,05, 0,10 de reflectancia). La validacion elige el angulo SAM y nada mas.
